history.title: History
history.explainer: Every message you own, newest first — back to the first one.
history.explainerMore: Nothing here has moved: each message is still where your mail server keeps it, and its row names that folder. The months and years on the right jump anywhere in it.
history.explainerMoreLabel: What History holds, and where it lives
history.emptyHint: Your mail appears as it syncs.
